image_description: A close-up, high-resolution image of a small wood rabbit (cottontail) being held gently in a human hand. The rabbit has dense, textured brown and grey fur with distinct individual hairs visible. Its ears are upright with pinkish interiors and dark tips. One large, dark eye is clearly visible on the side of its head. The rabbit's front paws are tucked near its chest, resting against the human fingers holding it. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green, suggesting an outdoor natural setting.
